req.title: Reject malformed player payload
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when POST /players/ receives a body that fails Player schema validation.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-009 requires HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives a body failing PlayerRequestModel schema validation. PlayerRequestModel has three required fields (first_name, last_name, position) and one required int (squad_number). Tests cover: (1) positive — a fully valid payload returns 201, confirming the happy path and that 422 is not spuriously returned; (2) negative EP — completely empty body returns 422; (3) negative EP — body missing all required fields returns 422; (4) negative DT — body missing only one required field (first_name) returns 422; (5) negative DT — body missing only last_name returns 422; (6) negative DT — body missing only position returns 422; (7) negative DT — body missing only squad_number returns 422; (8) BVA — squad_number supplied as a non-integer string triggers 422; (9) BVA — body is valid JSON but wrong type (array instead of object) returns 422. Each test asserts the exact status code constant (422 or 201) to catch comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_valid_payload_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 99 is not present in the pre-loaded dataset
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid PlayerRequestModel payload (all required fields present and correctly typed, squad_number=99)
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, position, squadNumber matching the submitted values
Response body contains an id field (UUID)
trace: R-PLAYER-009 — positive path: valid payload must NOT trigger 422
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_valid_payload_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_422_response_structure_contains_detail_list():
    r = client.post("/players/", json={})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code != 500
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    detail = body["detail"]
    assert isinstance(detail, list)
    assert len(detail) > 0
    first_error = detail[0]
    assert "loc" in first_error
    assert "msg" in first_error
    assert "type" in first_error
